comparison: Semantic caller cancellation after silent inner completion: one provider request, cancellation reported and no successful completion. Pi uses its real OpenAI SDK stream for both native stream consumption and final-result consumption; .NET exercises both IChatClient call modes.
limitations: Pi fetch returns an empty SSE stream and onResponse aborts the caller before completion. The .NET native client cancels the caller and returns silently. Request/idle deadline guards are separately covered by deterministic native tests and a real saved-settings CLI loopback; this comparison does not establish timeout error text, all SDK adapters, or bounded settlement for an indefinitely uncooperative inner client.

characterization.finding: Both call modes accepted empty completion after the request deadline or caller cancellation; a stream also accepted empty completion after its idle deadline. The existing throwing-provider idle test still passed.

trigger.finding: The real saved-settings CLI timeout fixture returned success instead of exit 1. This newly discovered provider gap is independent of auth locking.

implementation: The timeout boundary checks caller cancellation and monotonic request/last-wire-activity deadlines after each inner response or stream advance, including empty completion. Wire bytes still reset idle timing; request deadline has priority. Existing thrown cancellation/timeout translation remains.

verification.scope: Combined working tree includes the separately recorded auth and fixture corrections. The real saved-settings CLI test verifies timeout exit 1 and no late content.
